conformance_rule: Only features explicitly registered as chronological exogenous/PIT context may be intentionally carried unchanged into the null. Every feature derived wholly or partly from stock OHLCV, returns, or dynamic-peer stock paths must be recomputed exclusively from the synthetic path using the production builders. No chronology-derived stock-path feature may be copied from the original tape.
controlling_null_requirement: Claude H.7: stock returns block-permuted while preserving cross-sectional factor structure and market path so features carry no forward information.
empirical_evidence: On the controlled Fold0 Train80 fixture, all 42/42 stock-path-derived fields changed and all dynamic-peer fields changed.

identical_stock_features.days_since_earnings__v1: Derived from PIT earnings-event chronology, not from stock price chronology; deliberately remains aligned to real event calendar while synthetic returns are permuted.
identical_stock_features.earnings_estimate_eps__v1: PIT published earnings-event value; exogenous stock-specific chronological context, not price-derived.
identical_stock_features.earnings_event_count__v1: PIT earnings-event registry field; event chronology/context, not price-derived.
identical_stock_features.earnings_event_session__v1: PIT earnings-event calendar/session indicator; exogenous chronological event context, not price-derived.
identical_stock_features.earnings_reported_eps__v1: PIT published earnings-event value; exogenous stock-specific chronological context, not price-derived.
identical_stock_features.earnings_surprise_pct__v1: PIT published earnings-event value; exogenous stock-specific chronological context. Null reassigns synthetic returns against this unchanged chronology.
identical_stock_features.earnings_timing_known__v1: PIT publication/timing-availability field; chronological information-set context, not price-derived.
identical_stock_features.eligible: PIT earnings-registry availability/eligibility field; exogenous chronological event context, not derived from synthetic price/volume chronology.

market_policy: External market/context bank remains chronological and identical.
numerical_change_policy_detail: The observed 42/42 stock-path-derived features changing on the controlled fixture is strong empirical evidence, but numerical inequality is not an absolute present or future conformance requirement. A correctly rebuilt synthetic-path feature may coincidentally equal its original value without violating conformance.
provenance_boundary: Only the eight explicitly registered PIT/exogenous stock-context fields may be intentionally carried unchanged. Every feature derived wholly or partly from stock OHLCV, returns, or dynamic-peer stock paths must be recomputed exclusively from the completed synthetic path using production builders.
required_invariant_policy: Provenance registry defines conformance; numerical inequality does not. Unchanged fields must be a subset of the explicitly registered chronological exogenous/PIT context.
